key_insight: AiraXiv is an open-access publishing platform designed for a hybrid ecosystem of human and AI scientists: it uses scalable hardware and AI-driven services to automate submission processing, provenance tracking, and curation so research can scale without overwhelming traditional conference/journal workflows.
problem_solved: Addresses rising submission volumes, reviewer overload, trust/provenance gaps for AI-generated content, and the need for infrastructure that supports automated authorship, review, and discovery at scale.
method: End-to-end platform architecture combining scalable storage/compute infrastructure with AI services for automated ingestion, indexing, and metadata/provenance capture.
Hybrid human–AI workflows: AI agents assist or perform authoring, summarization, review triage and curation while humans validate outcomes and provide final governance.
Transparent provenance, versioning and reputation metadata (author type tags, audit logs, model IDs) plus metrics and APIs for discoverability and reproducibility.
impact: Enables faster, more reliable dissemination and discovery of research while reducing reviewer workload and improving provenance for AI-generated content—helpful for practitioners who need scalable, trustworthy access to the literature and machine-readable APIs for downstream tools.
visual_elements: Platform architecture diagram showing storage/compute, AI services (authoring/review/curation), and user layers (human & AI scientists).
Workflow infographic: submission → automated checks/provenance capture → AI-assisted triage/review → publication/versioning → discovery/consumption.
Trust/provenance flowchart illustrating metadata (author type, model ID, audit log) and how consumers verify origin and changes.
Comparative bar chart or icon set showing reduced reviewer workload, faster turnaround, and increased throughput vs. traditional venues.
paper_title: AiraXiv: An AI-Driven Open-Access Platform for Human and AI Scientists
paper_authors: Junshu Pan, Panzhong Lu, Yixuan Weng, Qiyao Sun, Fang Guo
